payload.title: CMS staging branch spec for a static-reader site lacks the Papyrus-source fetch steps, and its cd web must run in a subshell
payload.description: Found 2026-10-12 on Anth.us (CMS app d7s858igkyct5, branch staging). The staging spec generated for a markus-static reader runs export-published and then the site's web/build_via_papyrus.py, but (1) it has no step that fetches the pinned Papyrus source (the PAPYRUS_PIN clone/checkout that reader.preBuildCommands provides in the reader spec), so PAPYRUS_ROOT for the site build points at nothing unless the site hand-adds the steps; (2) the build command does 'cd web && ...' in the shared shell, so the later 'papyrus ops content upload-preview --dir web/dist-papyrus' runs from web/ and fails: it must run in a subshell '(cd web && ...)'. Fix in infra/amplify-app-shell/lib/build-specs.ts: include reader.preBuildCommands in the staging spec for static readers and wrap the cd in a subshell. Also note the Anth.us web/build_via_papyrus.py read the content submodule, not content-export, so the staging build was not actually CMS-driven.
